identitySignals: The name closely matches the agenda's 'Sacred Groves Traditions'. The website and Facebook page say 'Sacred Grove Traditions', and the About page names 'Sacred Grove Traditions, LLC.' The agenda spelling has an extra 's'.
The business is in Oakland, CA (385 14th Street Ste 582, 94612), matching the agenda location.

The website describes a youth mentorship and rites-of-passage program (YEWAS) for girls ages 7-18, plus health education and midwifery training. This is plausibly consistent with a high school college and career exploration MOU, but it is a weak signal.
I found no public page that links this business to OUSD or the ECCCO program. I also found no registry record (California Secretary of State, SAM.gov, IRS).
research.notes: Medium confidence only, so this should not be published. The agenda spells the name 'Sacred Groves Traditions' and the organization uses 'Sacred Grove Traditions'. I could not confirm a link to OUSD, and I did not reach the California Secretary of State, SAM.gov or IRS records, so there is no EIN, entity number or UEI. The Facebook page lists a different email (sacredgrovetraditions7@gmail.com) from the website's contact page (sacredgrove7@gmail.com). The contact page invites inquiries to a named individual, but I used only the general inbox. The business is an LLC, so it is not treated as an individual contracting under their own name.

profile.summary: Sacred Grove Traditions is an Oakland, California business that provides health education, training and natural reproductive health care services, including midwifery, with a focus on Black women and girls. It also runs YEWAS, a rites-of-passage and mentorship program for girls ages 7 to 18.
